headline: ChatGPT can peek at your Chrome tabs now
summary: ChatGPT's Chrome extension now accesses your open browser tabs. OpenAI demonstrated the new capability for web and desktop apps. The feature allows ChatGPT to view tabs when Chrome is tagged.

headline: Sega pulls Total War: Shogun 2 remaster from sale following disastrous launch
summary: Sega has removed Total War: Shogun 2 - Complete Edition from sale. The remaster faced widespread user complaints about bugs and AI upscaling. The game was pulled shortly after its Tuesday launch.

headline: The tech backlash is now in theaters
summary: Hollywood is releasing a wave of critical films about Silicon Valley. Movies like "The Social Reckoning" portray tech founders negatively. Films are exploring the disruptive and often destabilizing impact of tech.

headline: Trump posts AI-edited photo to brag about White House restoration work
summary: Donald Trump shared an AI-modified photo of White House renovations. The image, comparing old and "restored" columns, had discrepancies. Google's AI detector flagged the photo as potentially AI-generated.

headline: Pro Dota 2 Player Claims He Had to Play a Full Match in Front of Police Officers to Prove His Identity
summary: A pro Dota 2 player claims he played a match for police. This was to prove his identity after a team boot camp raid. He successfully demonstrated his skills under pressure.

headline: The Tiny Lisen 10,000mAh Power Bank With 45W USB-C Output Drops to $23.99
summary: Lisen's 10,000mAh power bank is on sale for $23.99. It offers 45W USB-C output, suitable for devices like the Switch. This power bank can significantly extend Nintendo Switch 2 playtime.

headline: Mortal Kombat Creator Ed Boon Responds to Street Fighter Cast Saying They Want a Crossover Movie
summary: Ed Boon, Mortal Kombat co-creator, is open to a crossover movie. The Street Fighter cast expressed enthusiasm for a joint film. Boon suggests a game crossover should happen before a movie.

headline: The BROTTAR Corner Display Cabinet Drops to $89.99 With Coupon, More Room to Showcase Your Collection
summary: The BROTTAR Corner Display Cabinet is discounted to $89.99. It features motion-sensing 3-color LED lighting. The cabinet provides ample space for collections with soft-close hinges.

headline: Bus hits train stopped on French side of Channel Tunnel, with 19 injured
summary: A bus collided with a stationary train in the Channel Tunnel. 19 people were injured in the incident on the French side. Two individuals were airlifted to hospital, but injuries are not life-threatening.

headline: Trump calls off livestream of Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad
summary: Donald Trump cancelled the livestream of Nidal Hasan's execution. Hasan, the Fort Hood attacker, is the first military execution in over 60 years. Trump cited that some would "rather not watch" the event.

headline: Trans people should use hospital spaces according to biological sex, NHS England says
summary: NHS England issued new guidance for trans patients in hospitals. Patients should be cared for in single-sex wards aligning with their biological sex. This guidance aims to clarify hospital space usage for trans individuals.

headline: Russell Brand accuser says he turned 'monster-like' before alleged rape
summary: An accuser described Russell Brand as becoming "monster-like". Brand faces multiple charges, including three counts of rape. The allegations relate to his behavior before an alleged sexual assault.
